2,454 likes, 109 comments - fitmom.club on March 27, 2025: "Leaving my job to fully dedicate myself to building FitMom.Club was one of the toughest yet most rewarding decisions I’ve ever made.
There were so many challenges along the way, so many ups and downs.
It’s truly heartwarming to be recognized for this journey at @kidsstoppprress

A huge thank you to @mansi.zaveri for recognizing our work and pushing us to continue empowering women every single day. 
 And to every single person who voted for us – your belief in this community has truly touched my heart ❤️ 

[Mom, Lifestyle, Award, Weightloss ]".
